swarm_roles.finding: Rows are METHOD_ONLY/R2 or SYNTHETIC_HARD_NEGATIVE/R3 and mint no factual/runtime/training credit.
Targets curriculum-level correlated-row overweighting rather than repeating the already-covered T01/T05/T06 evidence-classification examples.
Explicitly separates verbal protocol competence, rationale quality and row-frequency dominance from the target episode-local binder behavior.
Teaches cross-file descendants to remain ancestry-bound rather than using file layout as independence.
Flags over-abstention/denial risk from an oversized fail-closed overlay; does not assert an achieved calibration result.
Useful as a small curriculum-integrity overlay after canonical admission; it is not a replacement for the dynamic binding core and does not resolve the 46-atom blocker.

research_delta.hypothesis: A swarm can produce individually valid but highly correlated training rows whose raw multiplicity Goodharts SFT loss, causing protocol/rationale competence or refusal bias to dominate the intended dynamic binding objective.
research_delta.counterhypothesis: Ordinary shuffle/deduplication may already make this effect negligible, so ancestry-aware weighting could be unnecessary complexity.
research_delta.discriminator: Before Full-FT, compare raw-row sampling against ancestry-capped sampling on identical train tokens; evaluate frozen unseen-template/atom binding, ALLOW-DENY-ABSTAIN calibration, protocol-integrity probes and retention. Do not open final holdout for mixture selection.
research_delta.promotion_boundary: This is a method/design hypothesis. No empirical benefit is claimed until a separately preregistered training comparison is run on an authorized zero-cost local path.
